# Epigraphs: one per arc opening and per separate story segment
Format read by tools/context_pack.py. Fictional, original, no spoilers; many gain meaning later.

## Arc openings
Ch 1 | "Nobody looks up at a roof. That is why the wise sleep there." - Saying of the Hallowcrest groundskeepers
Ch 51 | "Count the lanterns in a city and you will know who is afraid of the dark, and who sells the oil." - Lanternhouse ledger, flyleaf
Ch 101 | "Thirteen chairs, one table, and every knife beneath it polished." - Old Concord jest
Ch 151 | "A name kept hidden is still a name. It only waits." - Verandel naming rite
Ch 201 | "The narrowest water holds the widest grief." - Crimson Rampart watch-song
Ch 251 | "What the grey takes, it does not keep. Go and ask for it back." - Mansakar griot verse
Ch 301 | "A court can hang a man for being feared. It needs no rope for that." - Inquisitor Theodora, private notes
Ch 351 | "The deep refuses what the shallows welcome." - Jayavara sailors' proverb
Ch 401 | "Everything made remembers the hand that made it." - Inscription over a Valkyrie forge
Ch 451 | "Mountains do not die. They wait for someone to climb them again." - Tawanqar terrace song
Ch 501 | "When the gods argue, the mortals are the floor they pace on." - Saravant astrologers' saying
Ch 551 | "Walk south until the world stops answering. Then keep walking." - Coalition order of march
Ch 601 | "The wound does not close quietly." - Ivory Order field manual
Ch 651 | "Write a man's name in your book and you will think he belongs to you." - Kremhold street saying
Ch 701 | "There is a road through nothing. Only the loyal remember it." - Fragment, the Pillars' oath
Ch 751 | "Some things must end. Some must be kept. Some have not begun." - Unfinished lullaby, last verse
Ch 801 | "Say it aloud. It is yours." - Verandel wedding custom

## Interludes and side stories
Ch 10 | "Rules are for people who intend to keep their promises." - Lysette Hollen, Discipline Committee handbook, margin note
Ch 20 | "A prince learns to win. A king learns what winning costs." - Aurenmark nursery maxim
Ch 30 | "A ballad is a lie told so that a heart can say the truth." - Duke Aldous Argentine, unpublished verse
Ch 40 | "Every form has a box for the dead. I have never once been allowed to leave it empty." - Ysolde Lisle, office note

## Comedy and slice-of-life specials
Ch 14 | "An absence is a debt. Debts are collected." - Discipline Committee motto, unofficial
Ch 19 | "The cooking club regrets nothing. The east kitchen regrets everything." - Hallowcrest incident report
Ch 28 | "Silverfell serves dinner at seven, assassins at eight." - House Argentine staff saying
Ch 53 | "One member is a secret. Two is a club. Three is a war over tomatoes." - Rooftop Garden Club charter
Ch 69 | "Never bet against the boy who sleeps through tourneys." - Hallowcrest betting slip
Ch 85 | "No one recognized the Duke. Everyone recognized the Duke." - Silverfell household log
Ch 103 | "A festival is a battle with better food." - Year 6 committee minutes
Ch 119 | "Memo the forty-first: re: ducks." - Office of the Crown Prince
Ch 164 | "Condensation is a perfectly ordinary thing." - Bertram Quell
Ch 622 | "A war is no place for a kitten. The kitten disagrees." - Gorrath, the Bastion
Ch 661 | "The household does not invade. The household helps, loudly." - Greta Vos
Ch 666 | "A roof garden holds forty guests. Forty-one if one of them sleeps standing." - Wedding planning ledger
Ch 703 | "Pack light. The Void has no laundry." - Vesk, the Lantern-Eyed
Ch 712 | "Even nothing gossips, if you listen." - Vesk, the Lantern-Eyed
Ch 805 | "Lectures begin when the lecturer wakes." - Hallowcrest timetable footnote
Ch 812 | "I have retired. I will be back after lunch." - Duke Aldous Argentine
Ch 820 | "Three nations, one kitchen, no survivors among the pans." - Contest judges' report
Ch 828 | "We were never asleep. We were waiting for a reason." - Toast of the Ten

## Weddings and epilogue
Ch 835 | "Have you eaten today?" - Question asked every day for the rest of it
Ch 840 | "Clause one: stay." - Courtship proposal, amended in ink
Ch 845 | "Washed, finally." - Note pinned to a handkerchief
Ch 850 | "The roof was green again, and nobody looked up. That was fine. He was not hiding anymore." - Last page of a Hallowcrest yearbook
